info.title: unshackle
info.description: Migrates .NET code away from libraries that went commercial: FluentAssertions → Shouldly, MediatR → Mediator, AutoMapper → hand-written mappings, Moq → NSubstitute, Polly v7 → Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience, EPPlus → ClosedXML; MassTransit v8 inventory. Roslyn-based, with a report and --dry-run; what it cannot rewrite safely is reported as manual work.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Migrate .NET code away from libraries that went commercial.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Run a fix and report what it would change, without writing code.

options.name: --fix
options.description: The fix to run, see 'unshackle list'.

options.name: --report
options.description: Write every finding to this file (.csv, .json, .md).

options.name: --force
options.description: Write even when the working tree is dirty, not a git repository, or git fails; overwrite an existing report. [default: False]

options.name: --sequential
options.description: Fix one file at a time instead of several in parallel (same output). [default: False]

options.name: --max-degree
options.description: Fix at most this many files at once (default: the processor count, at most 8); lower it when memory runs out.

options.name: --check-every-file
options.description: Run the patterns on every file, also those without a trace of the old library (same output; for comparison runs). [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to a .sln, .slnx or project file. Default: the only solution in the current directory.
